Title: Generally Available: Cross Region Restore of SQL and HANA database backups from a vault with Private Endpoints enabled

Body.Content: Azure Backup users can now perform Cross-Region Restore (CRR) of SQL and HANA backups if the vault has private endpoints enabled. You can create Secondary Private Endpoints in the vault and initiate CRR to the secondary region. To learn more on the steps needed to follow for performing CRR, refer: How to create and manage private endpoints (with v2 experience) for Azure Backup - Azure Backup | Microsoft Learn
